items.title: Pochettino seeks lucky break at crisis-hit Man Utd
items.summary: Manchester United head coach Mauricio Pochettino is seeking a turnaround in form as the club contends with poor defensive displays and an unexpected Premier League relegation threat. High error rates and discipline issues have left the Red Devils in a difficult position as they prepare to host Brentford. The manager has urged his squad to believe in their system and cut out individual mistakes to revive their season.
items.why: A protracted crisis at Manchester United carries huge sporting and financial consequences for one of the world's most valuable football brands.

items.title: CBN appoints Murtala Mohammed as acting CEO of Keystone Bank
items.summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) has appointed Murtala Mohammed as the acting Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Keystone Bank, replacing Hassan Imam. The apex bank stated that the change is consistent with its regulatory mandate under the Banks and Other Financial Institutions Act to ensure financial stability. It also assured customers and depositors that Keystone Bank's operations remain fully operational and secure.
items.why: Maintaining leadership stability at Keystone Bank is vital to protecting depositor funds and preserving overall confidence in the Nigerian banking sector.

items.title: Dangote Refinery Heads for Historic Dec 1 Listing on NGX
items.summary: Dangote Petroleum Refinery & Petrochemicals is set to list on the Nigerian Exchange (NGX) on December 1, 2026, marking a major milestone for the domestic capital market. The listing follows a widely subscribed initial public offering that attracted around 3.8 million investors across 121 countries. The move expands retail ownership in one of Africa's largest industrial assets through accessible digital platforms.
items.why: The landmark listing deepens the Nigerian capital market and broadens public participation in the nation's energy sector.

items.title: Nigeria, Togo target up to $50 million investment in joint data park project
items.summary: Nigeria and Togo are targeting an initial investment of $30 million to $50 million to develop two joint data parks. The project aims to attract global data center operators and significantly strengthen digital infrastructure within the West African sub-region. It represents a coordinated effort to expand regional cloud capacity and cross-border tech investments.
items.why: Strengthening cross-border digital infrastructure is essential for driving West Africa's digital economy and reducing dependency on foreign data hosting.

items.title: NAFDAC Shuts Down Zuba Market, Seizes Counterfeit Products Worth Over ₦300m
items.summary: The National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control (NAFDAC) has shut down Zuba International Market in Abuja after confiscating counterfeit and substandard goods worth over ₦300 million. The enforcement exercise, conducted across more than 160 shops in collaboration with the Police and DSS, is aimed at flushing out harmful products ahead of the festive season. The agency warned that heightened surveillance will continue to protect consumers from unscrupulous vendors.
items.why: Cracking down on fake drugs and unwholesome foods is critical to preventing public health hazards during peak consumer shopping periods.
